_meta.name: Cyber Safety Cop Instagram Template
_meta.brand: Cyber Safety Cop (@cybersafetycop) — online child-safety education for parents
_meta.usage: Bright, calm, empowering. Sunny yellow + electric blue, HEAVY bold sans (no italic/serif/script). Filled solid-blue numbered circles. Calm-not-alarmist tone. Logo is composited on top later (leave a clean top zone).

color_roles.#FFDE59: Sunny brand yellow — dominant background on listicle/stat posts. NEVER muted or pastel.
color_roles.#057AC0: Electric blue — pills, FILLED numbered circles, big numerals, CTAs, swooshes.
color_roles.#646668: Dark gray — headline + body text on yellow/white.
color_roles.#FFFFFF: White text on blue, card fills.

FORBIDDEN: HOLLOW numbered circles (that's Omega — CSC circles are FILLED solid blue with white numerals)
coral / Bright Canary pink (only on co-branded CSC_I posts)

BRAND.name: Cyber Safety Cop
BRAND.voice: Calm, empowering, practical guide — helps parents feel capable, never scared. No fear-mongering, no shocked-mom cliché, no predator panic.
BRAND.logo_usage: Logo (circular people icon) + CYBERSAFETYCOP.COM appears on every post, but is COMPOSITED ON TOP afterward — never generated. Leave a clean solid-color top ~12% zone for it.

TYPOGRAPHY.display: HEAVY bold geometric sans (Poppins ExtraBold / Montserrat / Bebas style), mixed-case. Headlines command via WEIGHT and CASE.
TYPOGRAPHY.rule: NO italic, NO serif, NO script — that is another brand's pattern. CSC is bold sans only.
TYPOGRAPHY.body: Regular/medium sans, dark gray or white, generous line height.
TYPOGRAPHY.eyebrow: Solid blue pill, white ALL-CAPS bold label.

A_numbered_listicle_yellow.description: Sunny yellow full background. Blue header pill, bold heavy-sans headline (dark gray), then 3-4 numbered rows each with a FILLED solid-blue circle + white numeral + a short item. The workhorse.
A_numbered_listicle_yellow.when_to_use: PRIMARY — tips, settings, 'X things parents should…', step lists

D_big_number_hero.description: Yellow background. Huge electric-blue numeral as the focal point + a bold heavy-sans topic headline + short body. Optional warm parent+child photo on the bottom half.

C_command_overlay_photo.description: Full-bleed warm photo of a parent + child (calm, positive — NOT scared). A blue or yellow translucent band over the lower portion carries a bold heavy-sans command headline (white) + short body.
C_command_overlay_photo.when_to_use: Photo-led tips, reassurance, 'talk to your kids' moments

G_review_card.description: Blue or white field. A row of yellow stars, a bold-sans parent quote, light attribution.

GLOBAL_HARD_RULES: Sunny yellow #FFDE59 (saturated, never pastel) + electric blue #057AC0 are the brand colors.
Numbered lists use FILLED solid-blue circles with WHITE numerals — NEVER hollow rings.
Headlines are HEAVY bold sans, mixed-case — NO italic, NO serif, NO script. Command via weight and case.
Calm, empowering, NEVER alarmist — no fear-mongering, no shocked/panicked parent, no horror palette, no predator imagery. Warm, positive parent-and-child moments.
Coral / Bright Canary pink appears ONLY on co-branded comparison posts — never on standard posts.
DO NOT bake the logo or CYBERSAFETYCOP.COM into the image — it is composited on top afterward. Leave a clean solid-color top ~12% zone for it.
FULL-BLEED: fills the canvas edge-to-edge; no outer border/frame/rounded-corners/floating card.
Render every word crisply and correctly spelled.
GLOBAL_NEGATIVE_PROMPT: italic, serif, script font, hollow numbered circles, muted yellow, pastel yellow, coral, pink, Bright Canary palette, alarmist, fear-mongering, shocked parent, panicked face, scared child, predator, horror palette, dark moody, logo, CYBERSAFETYCOP.COM, watermark, border, outer frame, rounded outer corners, drop shadow, floating card, misspelled or garbled text
